summary: The regression is witnessed twice and now causally controlled, but every witness so far widened the window by holding the store write open, so the honest question left is how often the interleaving happens on its own rather than whether it is possible. This turn spends one execution on bounding that instead of on another deliberate demonstration. The probe uses the same single node and the same fast-path transport with no instrumented store at all: the node is kept cycling between being deposed by empty heartbeats and starting its own election while the heartbeat stream continues, and the term is sampled continuously for a fall below the highest term the node has already adopted. The reading rule is stated in advance so the result cannot be spun either way. A fall observed there is a monotonicity violation under natural timing, which would make the finding deployment-relevant rather than demonstration-only. No fall in the window bounds the natural rate at the measured delivery count instead of refuting the mechanism, and the delivery count is the operand that makes that negative interpretable, since a window a microsecond wide cannot be expected to be hit by chance often. I recorded the refined discriminator on the same investigation and cited the two saved premises it relies on, the unguarded read-modify-write and the control showing the held write alone is monotone, so the probe is explicitly about rate rather than about attribution. No interpretation is recorded until the receipt exists. The harness and the update both validate, and the six witnessed findings, the reproduced regression with its causal control, and the two knowledge corrections remain recorded and unaffected.
